small_class_policy: Use fixed keyword predictions for a target/fold if either resolved training class has fewer than five articles; record fallback separately. Do not weaken related-report protection.
selection: Maximise pooled out-of-fold positive-class F1 averaged equally over the three targets. Use one C and one threshold shared across targets per representation. Include explicit rule fallbacks in the operational comparison. Ties prefer keyword, then TF-IDF, then embeddings; within a learned method prefer smaller C, then threshold closest to 0.5, then smaller threshold. These are development selection scores, not untouched test performance.
event_constraint: Threat and disruption predictions require predicted relevance; probabilities remain raw, and only binary predictions are gated.

embedding.chunking: Tokenize the complete fixed input once without truncation. Partition all content token IDs into non-overlapping consecutive chunks allowing space for tokenizer special tokens. Pass IDs directly to the frozen SentenceTransformer, without decode/re-tokenize.
embedding.pooling: L2-normalize each chunk embedding, mean weighted by content-token count, then L2-normalize the article vector.

keyword.scope: Require geography, transport and security terms within one 700-character window. Threat/disruption terms must occur in such a window. A lexical baseline, not an implementation of full semantic annotation rules; it can mistake hypothetical, negated, historical or background reporting for current events. Frozen before scoring.
